intro.zh: 在这次检索范围内，马斯克几乎没有用自己的原创长文在 X 上宣布或详述 Tesla 与 SpaceX 的合并。实质性表态主要出现在 2026-10-20 的 SpaceX 财报电话会和 2026-11-18 的 DealBook 峰会；在 X 上，他多半是转发别人整理的原话。下面按时间从新到旧，列出资料中与合并、或与两家公司业务纽带有关的帖子。时间显示为亚洲/新加坡。
intro.en: In the posts reviewed for this dossier, Musk barely used an original long post on X to announce or spell out a Tesla–SpaceX merger. The substantive comments were at the SpaceX earnings call on 20 October 2026 and the DealBook Summit on 18 November 2026. On X he mostly reposted other people's transcripts. Below, newest first, are the posts in the dossier that relate to the merger or to business ties between the two companies. Times are shown in Asia/Singapore.

text.zh: @stevenmarkryan 我将每年再向美国所有孩子各捐一股 SpaceX。
text.en: @stevenmarkryan I will be donating another share of SpaceX to all kids in America every year

note.zh: 把 Trump Account 赠股变成每年一次的个人承诺。股数未披露。
note.en: Turns the Trump Account gift into an annual personal pledge. Share counts not disclosed.

text.zh: @TSLAFanMtl 没有不可逾越的优势，但至少目前 SpaceX 领先世界其他对手一个数量级，而且差距似乎在扩大。
text.en: @TSLAFanMtl No advantage is insurmountable, but, at least for now, SpaceX is beating the rest of the world by an order of magnitude and that lead appears to be widening

note.zh: 回复一条关于轨道 AI 算力经济性的帖子，发于 FCC 批准 Starmind 之后。
note.en: Reply to a post on orbital AI economics, after the FCC Starmind approval.

text.zh:
如果 SpaceX 成功让生命成为多行星物种，并利用哪怕百万分之一的太阳能量，它的价值将约为当前全球经济的一百万倍。

这些显然是极其困难的目标，但有路径可以实现。

我建议你们继续持有股票。
text.en:
If SpaceX succeeds in making life multiplanetary and harnessing even a millionth of the Sun’s energy, it will be worth about a million times the current global economy.

These are obviously absurdly difficult goals, but there is a path to achieving them.

I recommend holding on to your shares.

note.zh: 在赠股帖下的自我回复，建议获赠者继续持有 SPCX。未谈合并。
note.en: Self-reply in the share-gift thread telling recipients to hold their SPCX shares. Not about the merger.

text.zh: @2by32 在数字超级智能方面，SpaceX 连铜牌领奖台都还没站上。这让我难过。😢
text.en: @2by32 SpaceX is not yet even on the podium with a bronze medal when it comes to digital superintelligence. This makes me sad. 😢

note.zh: 马斯克承认 SpaceX（xAI 已并入）在 AI 竞赛中落后。
note.en: Musk concedes SpaceX (which now houses xAI) trails in the AI race.

text.zh:
SpaceX 的那一股将在下个月转出。

我个人直接给的那一股，将在明年 6 月我的锁定期到期时转出。
text.en:
The share from SpaceX will be transferred next month. 

The share directly from me will be transferred when my lockup expires in June next year.

note.zh: 赠股时间表；也说明他的 SPCX 锁定期到 2027 年 6 月。
note.en: Timing of the gift; also confirms his SPCX lockup runs to June 2027.

text.zh: 美国每个孩子都会得到两股 SpaceX 股票，一股来自公司，一股来自我个人。
text.en: Every child in America will receive two SpaceX shares, one from the company and one from me personally

note.zh: 当天点赞最多的帖子（50 万+）。未提合并。
note.en: His most-liked post of the day (500k+ likes). Did not mention the merger.

text.en:
RT @SpaceX: SpaceX is building the infrastructure of the future and working to make life multiplanetary. We believe ownership of the company creating these systems should extend to the next generation of Americans.
 
Today, we are committing one SpaceX share to millions of American children…
text.zh:
转发 @SpaceX：SpaceX 正在建设未来的基础设施，并致力于让生命成为多行星物种。我们相信，打造这些系统的公司的所有权应延伸到下一代美国人。

今天，我们承诺向数百万美国儿童每人捐赠一股 SpaceX 股份……

note.zh: SpaceX 向活跃 Trump Account 赠股的公告（CNBC 报道马斯克个人配捐）。与合并无直接关系，但涉及 SPCX 新股发行。
note.en: SpaceX's announcement of share gifts to active Trump Accounts (CNBC reports Musk will personally match). Not directly about the merger, but it involves issuing new SPCX shares.

text.en:
RT @GavinSBaker: A share of SpaceX for every child in America. Another share coming next year directly from Elon.

This is great for the country imo. No better way to teach the next generation about the virtues of capitalism.

Love to see more companies and founders do this.

Happy Thanksgiving!
text.zh:
转发 @GavinSBaker：美国每个孩子一股 SpaceX。明年还会有一股直接来自 Elon。

我认为这对国家很好。没有比这更好的方式教下一代认识资本主义的好处。

希望看到更多公司和创始人这样做。

感恩节快乐！

text.en:
SpaceX Colossus 3 will greatly benefit the Arizona community

[Quoting @SpaceX: Our supercompute site in Cochise County has been designed with Arizona in mind: no gas plant, no industrial water use, and a dry-cooling closed-loop water system. SpaceX will also invest $50B+ into the area, bringing 1,000 local permanent jobs and up to 5,500 construction jobs to…]
text.zh:
SpaceX Colossus 3 将大大造福亚利桑那社区

[引用 @SpaceX：我们在科奇斯县的超算基地充分考虑了亚利桑那：没有燃气电厂、不使用工业用水，采用干式冷却闭环水系统。SpaceX 还将在当地投资 500 亿美元以上，带来 1,000 个本地长期岗位和最多 5,500 个建设岗位……]

note.zh: SpaceX 地面 AI 算力投入的又一例，与合并讨论中的 AI/算力重叠有关。
note.en: Another example of SpaceX's ground-based AI compute spending, relevant to the AI/compute overlap in the merger debate.

text.en: @BrendanCarrFCC Much appreciated. This will be a great asset to America and the world.
text.zh: @BrendanCarrFCC 非常感谢。这将成为美国和世界的重要资产。

note.zh: 回复 FCC 主席 Carr 宣布批准 SpaceX 100 万颗卫星的「Starmind」轨道数据中心星座。
note.en: Reply to FCC Chairman Carr announcing approval of SpaceX's 1-million-satellite 'Starmind' orbital data-center constellation.

text.zh:
Starlink

[引用 @SawyerMerritt：SpaceX 同意放弃 7.38 亿美元美国联邦宽带补贴，改为向符合条件的美国家庭免费提供 Starlink 设备……]
text.en:
Starlink

[Quoting @SawyerMerritt: SpaceX has agreed to forgo $738 million in U.S. federal broadband subsidies and instead provide free @Starlink hardware to eligible American households. …]

note.zh: 与合并无直接关系；涉及 SpaceX 与美国政府补贴关系，是监管与政治审查背景的一部分。
note.en: Not directly about the merger; it concerns SpaceX's relationship with U.S. government subsidies, part of the regulatory and political-scrutiny backdrop.

text.zh: @WR4NYGov 纽时把显而易见的事当成「新闻」🙄
text.en: @WR4NYGov NYT is posting the obvious as “news” 🙄

note.zh: 回应《纽约时报》关于 SpaceX 向 Anthropic、谷歌出售算力的报道；该报道同日拖累 SPCX 下跌 5.65%。没有谈合并。
note.en: A response to the New York Times report that SpaceX sells compute to Anthropic and Google; that report weighed on SPCX, which fell 5.65% the same day. He did not discuss the merger.

text.zh:
[转发 @KatieMiller] @spacexai 一直禁止这种行为，采取了大量措施防止，而且已经很长时间没有用户绕过这些保护了。

这又是民主党出于政治原因针对 @elonmusk，而不是去解决科技领域长期存在的重大社会问题。
text.en:
RT @KatieMiller: .@spacexai has always prohibited this conduct, have taken extensive measures to prevent it, and haven't had any users evade those protections in a very long time.

This is another example of Democrats singling out @elonmusk for political reasons rather than tackling big, ongoing societal problems in tech.

note.zh: 原帖：https://x.com/KatieMiller/status/2124850376188874863 。发在弗吉尼亚、俄勒冈两州就 Grok 起诉 SpaceX 当天，是 SpaceX 一方对诉讼的回应；与合并没有直接关系，但涉及潜在收购方的法律风险。
note.en: Original: https://x.com/KatieMiller/status/2124850376188874863 . Posted the day Virginia and Oregon sued SpaceX over Grok; it is SpaceX's side responding to the suits. Not directly about the merger, but it concerns legal risk at the likely acquirer.

text.zh: @SawyerMerritt 中国除外，因为 Starlink 在那里是非法的
text.en: @SawyerMerritt Except in China, as Starlink is illegal there

note.zh: 回复 Sawyer Merritt 的帖子（称马斯克表示所有特斯拉车型到 2027 年底可能内置 Starlink，达拉斯的 Cybercab 已经装有）。原帖：https://x.com/SawyerMerritt/status/2124675012582093283 。说明 Starlink 与特斯拉的业务纽带在中国无法落地，与合并中的中国监管难点相关；没有谈合并条款。
note.en: Reply to Sawyer Merritt (who wrote that Musk says all Tesla models could get integrated Starlink by end of 2027, and Dallas Cybercabs already have it). Original: https://x.com/SawyerMerritt/status/2124675012582093283 . Shows the Starlink–Tesla tie cannot extend to China, relevant to the China regulatory hurdle for a merger; no merger terms discussed.

text.zh:
@davidmarcus 希望在明年年底前后推出。

这对无监督 FSD 很重要，让乘客在任何地方都有高带宽网络用于工作和娱乐。
text.en:
@davidmarcus Hopefully available towards the end of next year. 

This will be important for unsupervised FSD, so passengers have high bandwidth everywhere for work and entertainment.

note.zh: 回复 David Marcus 的帖子：「等不及特斯拉在所有车型（Cybercab 之外）提供内置 Starlink 选项了。」原帖：https://x.com/davidmarcus/status/2124662177693102590 。这是两家公司业务纽带（Starlink 进特斯拉车）的时间表表态，不是合并公告。
note.en: Reply to David Marcus: "Can't wait for Tesla to offer an embedded Starlink option in all models (beyond the Cybercab)." Original: https://x.com/davidmarcus/status/2124662177693102590 . A timing comment on a business tie between the companies (Starlink in Tesla cars), not a merger announcement.

text.zh: 特斯拉的超级智能软件、芯片设计和 Terafab 都是很好玩的工作地方
text.en: Tesla super intelligence software, chip design & Terafab are fun places to work

note.zh: 引用特斯拉 AI 团队 Julian Ibarz 的帖子（称端到端具身 AI 已部署到数百万辆车，大型世界模型由 Autopilot 与 Optimus 共用）。原帖：https://x.com/julianibarz/status/2124559848444694824 。是招聘性质，提到联合项目 Terafab，没有提合并。
note.en: Quotes a post by Tesla AI's Julian Ibarz (saying end-to-end embodied AI is shipped to millions of cars and a larger world model is shared between Autopilot and Optimus). Original: https://x.com/julianibarz/status/2124559848444694824 . A recruiting post that mentions the joint Terafab project; it does not mention a merger.

text.zh:
转发 @teslaownersSV：@elonmusk 被问到如果 SpaceX 和特斯拉合并，他是否应该领取特斯拉薪酬时，埃隆·马斯克说不：

「我不认为仅仅因为做了一笔合并，就应该得到任何形式的奖励。那不合理，也不正确。」

「你应该信守承诺，言出必行。」
text.en:
RT @teslaownersSV: @elonmusk Asked whether he should collect Tesla compensation if SpaceX and Tesla merge, Elon Musk said no:

"I don't think I should be compensated with any kind of award just for doing a merger. That would be unreasonable and not right."

"You should keep your deals and stay true to your word."

note.zh: 这是转发 @teslaownersSV 整理的 DealBook 原话，不是马斯克本人新写的长文。原帖：https://x.com/teslaownersSV/status/2123309405013987713 。DealBook 上「大概会更好在一起」的完整问答，资料里没有找到他另发的原创帖。
note.en: A repost of @teslaownersSV's transcript from DealBook, not a new long post written by Musk. Original: https://x.com/teslaownersSV/status/2123309405013987713 . The dossier did not find a separate original post from him with the full "probably yes / better together" exchange.

text.zh:
转发 @SpaceInvestor_D：$SPCX：萨提亚·纳德拉说微软会租用 SpaceX 的算力。

在 DealBook 上被问到马斯克关于太空数据中心的看法是否正确时：
「如果他有可以租给我的 SpaceX 算力，我会租。」
text.en:
RT @SpaceInvestor_D: $SPCX: Satya Nadella says Microsoft would rent SpaceX compute.

Asked at DealBook whether Musk is right about data centers in space:
"If he has SpaceX capacity that I can lease, I would lease it."

note.zh: 转发他人整理的 DealBook 片段，涉及 SPCX 的算力业务，不涉及合并条款。原帖：https://x.com/SpaceInvestor_D/status/2123211962289176891
note.en: A repost of someone else's DealBook clip about SPCX's compute business; nothing on merger terms. Original: https://x.com/SpaceInvestor_D/status/2123211962289176891

text.zh: 正在寻找硬核工程师加入 Terafab！
text.en: Looking for hardcore engineers to join Terafab!

note.zh: 截至 2026-11-19，他仍在为 Terafab 招募工程师。这是两家公司的联合项目，不是合并公告。
note.en: As of 19 November 2026 he was still recruiting engineers for Terafab. That is the companies' joint project, not a merger announcement.

text.zh:
转发 @KanekoaTheGreat：埃隆·马斯克预测超级智能算力将 100% 在太空，并说特斯拉和 SpaceX「大概」在一起会更好：

「放眼未来，轨道算力才是真正能规模化的地方。」
text.en:
RT @KanekoaTheGreat: Elon Musk predicts 100% of superintelligence compute will be in space, and says Tesla and SpaceX would “probably” be better together:

“If you look into the future, orbital compute is really going to be where things scale to.”

note.zh: 转发他人整理的 DealBook「大概会更好在一起」片段；接口返回的原帖文字被截断，这里只收录可见部分。原帖：https://x.com/KanekoaTheGreat/status/2123212134175949267
note.en: A repost of someone else's DealBook clip of the 'probably better together' remark. The original text returned by the API is truncated; only the visible part is included. Original: https://x.com/KanekoaTheGreat/status/2123212134175949267

text.zh:
SpaceX 和特斯拉在得州发展得很好，因为我们没有一直处在一个压迫性、汲取型的州政府之下。

而且我需要离工厂近，才能亲自到车间走动。所以 SpaceX 的第一座主要工厂在洛杉矶，特斯拉的第一座主要工厂在旧金山湾区。

随着加州因为极高的税收和过度监管变得越来越难做，我们把美国国内的主要扩建和总部迁到了得州。
text.en:
SpaceX and Tesla have prospered in Texas, because we were not constantly operating under an oppressive and extractive state government. 

And I need to be close to the factories, so that I can walk the floor in person. That’s why the first major SpaceX factory was in LA and first major Tesla factory was in SF Bay Area.

As California became increasingly difficult, due to extreme taxes and overregulation, we moved our major domestic expansions and HQ to Texas.

note.zh: 帖子同时提到两家公司，讲的是为什么把主要扩建和总部放在得州。它不是合并条款，也不是交易公告。
note.en: The post mentions both companies and explains why major expansions and headquarters moved to Texas. It does not state merger terms and it is not a deal announcement.

text.zh:
正是如此 😂

特斯拉没有政府合同，特朗普总统也终止了联邦对电动车的激励。

SpaceX 与政府的合同既是最好的产品，也是最低的价格！而且本季度政府收入将不到 SpaceX 收入的 10%，一年后将不到 5%。

政府不想要的合同，我很乐意取消。说一声就行！
text.en:
Exactly 😂

Tesla has no government contracts and President Trump ended federal incentives for electric vehicles. 

SpaceX contracts with the government are BOTH the best product AND the lowest price! Moreover government revenue will be less than 10% of SpaceX revenue this quarter and less then 5% a year from now. 

Happy to cancel any that the government doesn’t want. Just say the word!

note.zh: 帖子对比的是特斯拉没有政府合同、电动车联邦激励被终止，以及 SpaceX 的政府收入占比。它不是合并公告。英文原文中的 “less then” 按原帖保留。
note.en: The post contrasts Tesla's lack of government contracts and the end of federal EV incentives with SpaceX's share of government revenue. It is not a merger announcement. The original wording "less then" is kept as posted.

text.zh: 长期以来，特斯拉和 SpaceX 为数十万员工创造了可观的财富，也改善了数亿人的退休储蓄。
text.en: Tesla and SpaceX have created meaningful wealth for hundreds of thousands of employees over time and improved the retirement savings of hundreds of millions of people

note.zh: 与两家公司都有关，讲的是员工和退休账户的财富，不是合并公告。
note.en: About both companies, on wealth created for employees and retirement accounts. Not a merger announcement.

text.zh:
转发 @XFreeze：埃隆·马斯克谈可能的 SpaceX 与特斯拉合并：

「我觉得这是个好主意吗？是的。」

SpaceX 和特斯拉都已应股东要求，成立了由独立董事组成的特别委员会来讨论这个想法。

因为他是利益冲突方，埃隆不能参与这些讨论。

「外面有些人假定 SpaceX 和特斯拉的合并是必然的，我觉得这么说言过其实。」

「特别委员会还没有就任何交易的条款达成一致。显然，也不能保证他们会达成。」

在特斯拉这边，需要全部股份的 50% 同意，而不只是参与投票的股份。这是一个很高的门槛。

那么埃隆为什么支持？

「我确实认为把两家公司合在一起有很大价值，因为我们基本上已经处在超级智能奇点之中。」

「在开发超级智能软件、芯片设计、Terafab、当然还有机器人、以及用 Starmind 星座把质量送入轨道这些方面，合作能得到很多。还有连接能力。」

接下来，两家公司的特别委员会必须先就条款达成一致，然后再交给股东投票。
text.en:
RT @XFreeze: Elon Musk on a possible SpaceX–Tesla merger: 

"Do I think it would be a good idea? Yes"

Both SpaceX and Tesla have formed special committees of independent directors to discuss the idea, at the request of shareholders

Because he's a conflicted party, Elon can't take part in those discussions

"Some people out there assume that a SpaceX and Tesla merger is a certainty, and I think that would be overstating it"

"The special committees have not reached agreement on the terms of any transaction. And obviously there's no guarantee that they will"

On the Tesla side, it would need a 50% vote of all shares, not just those who vote. That's a high hurdle

So why does Elon support it?

"I do think there's a lot of merit to combining the companies as we are pretty much in the super intelligence singularity"

"There's a lot to be gained from cooperating on developing super intelligence software, chip design, the Terafab, obviously robotics, mass to orbit with the Starmind constellation. Connectivity"

Next, the special committees of both companies have to agree on terms, and then it goes to a shareholder vote

note.zh: 转发 @XFreeze 对 2026-10-20 SpaceX 三季报电话会的摘要，马斯克以转发背书这段原话。原帖：https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2112660528409747769 。这是资料里与合并最直接相关的一条 X 发言。
note.en: A repost of @XFreeze's summary of the 20 October 2026 SpaceX Q3 call; Musk endorsed the quotes by reposting them. Original: https://x.com/XFreeze/status/2112660528409747769 . This is the X post in the dossier most directly about the merger.

text.zh: Tesla x SpaceX
text.en: Tesla x SpaceX

note.zh: 该帖引用了 @Tesla 的 Roadster 活动直播。这是产品与品牌联动。巴克莱在 10 月 15 日的研报里曾预期这场活动会展示 SpaceX 的冷气推进器；帖子正文只有 “Tesla x SpaceX”，不宜直接读成企业合并公告。
note.en: The post quotes @Tesla's Roadster event livestream. It is a product and brand link. Barclays' 15 October note had expected the event to show a SpaceX cold-gas thruster; the post itself only says "Tesla x SpaceX" and should not be read as a corporate-merger announcement.

text.zh: 我非常粗略的猜测是，Terafab 的 AI 算力产出大约 25% 会给 Tesla Optimus，大约 75% 给 AI 航天器。
text.en: My very approximate guess is that Terafab AI compute output would be ~25% for Tesla Optimus and ~75% for AI spacecraft

note.zh: 对 Terafab 算力如何分给 Optimus 和 AI 航天器的粗略猜测。是联合项目的背景，不是合并公告。
note.en: A rough guess at how Terafab compute would split between Optimus and AI spacecraft. Background on the joint project, not a merger announcement.

text.zh: SpaceX IPO 信息
text.en: SpaceX IPO info

note.zh: 指向 SpaceX IPO 信息。上市是已发生的事实；这条帖子本身不是与特斯拉合并的公告。
note.en: Points to SpaceX IPO information. The listing did happen; this post is not an announcement of a merger with Tesla.

text.zh:
SpaceXAI + Tesla TERAFAB 项目

目标是每年一万亿瓦的算力

其中大部分必然要放到太空，因为美国的电力只有 0.5 太瓦
text.en:
SpaceXAI + Tesla TERAFAB Project 

Goal is a trillion watts of compute/year

Most must necessarily go to space, as US electricity is only 0.5TW

note.zh: Terafab 联合项目的后续说明。目标是每年一万亿瓦算力。不是企业合并公告。
note.en: A follow-up on the joint Terafab project. The stated goal is a trillion watts of compute a year. Not a corporate-merger announcement.

text.zh:
正式预告 TERAFAB 项目。该项目将由 @SpaceX 与 @Tesla 联合推进，今晚美国中部时间 8 点左右。在 𝕏 上直播。

目标是每年生产超过 1 太瓦的算力（逻辑、存储和封装），大约 80% 用于太空，大约 20% 用于地面。
text.en:
Formal announcement of the TERAFAB project, which will be done jointly by @SpaceX and @Tesla, tonight around 8pm CT. Livestream on 𝕏.

The goal is to produce over a TERAWATT of compute per year (logic, memory & packaging) with ~80% for space and ~20% for the ground.

note.zh: Terafab 的正式预告，由 SpaceX 与特斯拉联合推进。后来被反复引用为两家公司业务重叠、进而讨论合并的背景，但它本身不是合并公告。
note.en: The formal preview of Terafab, pursued jointly by SpaceX and Tesla. It was later cited often as background for the business overlap and the merger talks, but it was not itself a merger announcement.

text.zh:
@TEDchris 我原则上不反对这个想法，但不确定有没有务实或合法的办法把它们合并。

让各家公司员工的股权激励与该公司自己的成就挂钩，也有其价值。
text.en:
@TEDchris I’m not opposed to the idea in principle, but I’m not sure there is a pragmatic or legal way to merge them. 

There is also value in equity incentives of people at the companies being tied to that company’s accomplishments.

note.zh: 2024 年回复 TED 的 Chris Anderson 关于把各家公司并到一起的建议。原则上不反对，但怀疑有没有务实或合法的办法。当时没有交易。可与 2026 年他因 AI、机器人和芯片重叠而改口对照。
note.en: A 2024 reply to TED's Chris Anderson about folding the companies together. Not opposed in principle, but unsure there was a pragmatic or legal way. There was no transaction then. It contrasts with his 2026 comments as the AI, robotics and chip overlap grew.
